ambient_events: The shell hoist rattles up a few links and jams, then frees itself.
A worklight buzzes and browns out, then steadies.
The cradle grinds overhead and rust flakes drift down.
description: The bunker under the flak pit: a cramped rust-streaked box that smells of hot oil and old smoke. Crated shells stack to the ceiling beside a groaning hoist that feeds the gun above; a bench of cannibalised parts and half-mended mechanism runs the back wall. Slagworks built the gun ugly on purpose so it could take a hit and be dragged back to life down here. A steel ladder climbs to the buckled hatch and the open pit.
name: Slagworks Flak Pit — Bunker
